description: This file defines functions related to managing failover policies, such as determining whether to allow cooldown probes, use transient cooldown slots, or preserve transient cooldown slots based on different failover reasons.

methods.name: export function shouldAllowCooldownProbeForReason( shouldAllowCooldownProbeForReason
methods.description: Determines if a cooldown probe is allowed for a given failover reason.

methods.name: export function shouldUseTransientCooldownProbeSlot( shouldUseTransientCooldownProbeSlot
methods.description: Checks whether to use a transient cooldown probe slot based on the reason.

methods.name: export function shouldPreserveTransientCooldownProbeSlot( shouldPreserveTransientCooldownProbeSlot
methods.description: Decides if a transient cooldown probe slot should be preserved for certain failover reasons.
